column5: Imagine you are standing by a wide river, under a great suspension bridge.
Every bridge, every building, every tree around you was made for one force.
Now imagine that, in one minute, gravity doubles.
At first, you only feel tired.
At one and a half g, standing up feels like carrying a child on your back.
Cars sink low on their springs.
The bridge was built to hold its own weight.
At two g, you would weigh twice as much as you do now.
Your heart would have to work much harder to push blood up to your head.
Anything you dropped would hit the ground forty percent faster.
The air would press down twice as hard.
Everything we have ever built was made for one gravity.
